# Confirm Loan

## Story

As a reader, I want to confirm the loan after scanning, so that I know the
book is officially checked out to me.

**Acceptance criteria.**

- **Given** a scanned book, **when** I confirm the checkout, **then** a loan
  is recorded for the current member.
